en: A black and white vintage postcard showing a large, ornate public square with two prominent historical buildings. The left building is classical with a central pediment and symmetrical windows, while the right building has elaborate gothic architecture with pointed towers and detailed stonework. Several people in early 20th-century clothing are visible in the square. The title text at the top identifies the location and buildings.
